scope: Native FP32 implementation of the three locked lighting graphs; numerical equivalence and standalone timings, not Enfusion integration
input_layout: Interleaved little-endian FP32: model features in serialized order, original scene-linear source RGB, alpha, valid flag (0 or 1)
output_layout: Interleaved little-endian FP32: predicted log1p residual RGB, corrected scene-linear RGB, original alpha
output_operation: max(expm1(source log1p RGB + residual), 0); invalid pixels preserve original source RGB exactly; alpha always preserved
precision: FP32 weights, normalization, dense layers, activation and output; no quantization or retraining
fixture_scope: Deterministic original feature/mask/color controls at each size; these are numerical workloads, not rendered quality comparisons
rendered_cases: All 48 existing cross-courtyard test frames and both 32-frame regression paths, without rendering, fitting or candidate selection; compare native output against the retained CPU evaluation
